newsitem.title: CHINA: China farm bank's loans rise in 1996.
newsitem.headline: China farm bank's loans rise in 1996.

text.p: The Agriculture Bank of China has extended 357.24 billion yuan ($43 billion) in loans for agricultural production in 1996, up 45.78 billion yuan or 20.6 percent from 1995, the Farmers' Daily said on Wednesday.
The loans used for overall agriculture development accounted for 38 percent of total loans extended by the farm bank, the newspaper said.
The Agriculture Bank, one of China's four main state-owned banks, extended 776.9 billion yuan in loans in 1996, up 18.4 percent from last year, an earlier report said.
